The rate of progress in AI right now is unlike any other period in tech history. Models are getting cheaper on a like for like task basis, more generally capable, faster, and they’re going deeper in almost every domain. 

As intelligence becomes too cheap to meter, then the big opportunity is driving diffusion of AI into the economy. 

This is a great time to be applied AI company because there’s an incredible amount of innovation and competition acting as a tailwind to your own progress. Huge moment for startups right now that can take advantage of this.

AI diffusion is far more rate limited by having good evals than most realize. The kind of evals that you see for every model release are incredibly helpful, but only tell you the shape of general AI progress and the relative capability level of models.

The far bigger space over time are evals on all the major workflows that enterprises do, down to the specifics of an individual company. 

This will be a huge space over time because you can’t automate what you can’t assess the progress on. Enterprises will not be able to go just on vibes.

real story of how Grok @Bot saved the day

i own a lot of open source projects that in total have 24k+ stars on github. as a result i've been pretty overwhelmed by all the incoming issues and PRs

that just changed. if you filed issues or PRs on my repos, you might have noticed the queue is finally moving

this is mostly from 3 key changes i made -

1. defining a VISION.md for every repo i own (renaming to STRATEGY.md soon). i shared it in more detail here - https://t.co/stWlSMbZUV 

2. created a software factory setup with Grok Bot + Cursor cloud agents. i shared the setup here - https://t.co/xzLpUNs6BP

3. inviting a few maintainers who offered to help with issues that are triaged as vision-aligned

people might say "this could be done without Grok Bot as well" - true, but definitely not so easily and so low-maintenance

for example, having cursor cloud agents natively integrated in Grok Bot allows infinite horizontal scaling which is not something easily achievable in other similar systems. Grok Bot did a pretty great job bringing in the right primitives into a nicely integrated system
